_comment: The `neoforge:fluid_container` model loader is gone at 1.21.11 -- NeoForge ships only
`neoforge:empty`, `neoforge:obj` and `neoforge:composite` there -- so the composited bucket this
loader used to build from an empty bucket plus a tinted fluid overlay cannot be asked for. Without
this file the item has no model at all, which is the black-and-purple cube.
A plain empty bucket, matching what the 1.21.4 node falls back to. It is only reached if the
